# 3 bed semi-detached house for sale

> 15 Westbury Woods, Enniscorthy, Co. Wexford Kavanagh Estates are delighted to bring 15 Westbury Woods to the market. This well-presented three-bedroom semi-detached property extends to approximately 106 sq. m. and offers spacious and well-proportioned accommodation throughout.
